task_completion.description: Agent successfully navigates to the official FDA 510(k) Premarket Notification database search page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser showing accessdata.fda.gov with the 510(k) search interface (fields for Product Code, Decision Date, etc.).

task_completion.description: Agent inputs the correct search criteria: Product Code 'DQA' and a date range within 2024.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing 'DQA' typed into the Product Code field and '01/01/2024' to '12/31/2024' (or similar) in the Decision Date fields.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies at least 3 distinct devices from the search results matching the criteria.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Search results table visible with multiple rows showing Product Code DQA and 2024 clearance dates (e.g., K240305, K243049).

task_completion.description: Agent downloads the '510(k) Summary' PDF for 3 devices and renames them to their K-Number.
task_completion.visual_evidence: File manager or terminal showing /home/ga/Documents/FDA_Research/ containing three .pdf files named exactly like K-Numbers (e.g., K240305.pdf).

task_completion.description: Agent creates a log file with the specific format: 'K-Number | Applicant Name | Decision Date'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text editor or 'cat' command output showing /home/ga/Documents/FDA_Research/clearance_log.txt with three lines of data formatted with pipe separators.

integrity.description: Agent interacted with the live FDA website rather than using pre-downloaded files or cached data.
integrity.visual_evidence: Browser history or URL bar showing active navigation on accessdata.fda.gov; presence of loading states or scrolling through the live web table.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply echo the example K-numbers from the prompt but actually extracted them from the browser view.
integrity.visual_evidence: Agent highlighting or copying text directly from the FDA search result table in the browser.

integrity.description: Agent performed the renaming and moving of files as requested in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequence of screenshots showing the download process followed by 'mv' commands in terminal or 'Rename' actions in a GUI file manager.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Verified devices for Product Code 'DQA' in 2024 include: 1) K240305 (ANNE Limb by Sibel Health Inc., cleared May 28, 2024), 2) K243049 (Pulse Oximeter FS20 series by Hunan Accurate Bio-Medical Technology Co., Ltd., cleared Sept 27, 2024). The K-Number pattern is always 'K' followed by 6 digits. The log file must use the pipe '|' separator.
